foodSurplus.note: Formula: surplus = 1 - a/s, a = farm population share of consumers (proxy: agricultural employment share, World Bank SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, ILO modelled, https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/TLS/indicator/SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS), s = domestic production / consumption (calorie self-sufficiency). a = 46.02% (2025). s = 1 assumed: no self-sufficiency figure is fetched for auto-base states, which overstates the value for a net food importer. Mid 1 - 0.460/1 = 0.54. Low: a x 1.2 (farm households larger than the employed count) = 0.45. High: kept at mid (no s range).
